properties.notes: Full: Erection of 9 dwellings with associated access, parking and landscaping. Work has not started at this site. A further application at the site was dismissed at appeal. It is unclear as to the owners intentions. No Building Control records available. The owner has returned the Housing Land Survey form and indicated that they intend to start development within 1 year and complete it within 2-5 years.
